jobs_results.title: DevOps Product Owner
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

This is a remote position.

My client is looking for a DevOps Product Owner

Join a Cutting-Edge Fintech Revolutionizing Treasury Operations

The team of my clients are pioneers in integrating digital assets seamlessly into enterprise and institutional treasury operations. The journey began in 2017, founded by a team of seasoned experts in payments and security. With a mission to simplify the adoption of digital assets, they've crafted a platform that seamlessly integrates into your existing financial ecosystem, from payroll to cross-border transactions.

Your Impact:

They're on the lookout for a dynamic DevOps Product Owner to spearhead collaboration between our DevOps and infrastructure teams. As a pivotal figure, you'll bridge the gap between product development, stakeholders, and customers, driving our roadmap forward and ensuring the delivery of top-tier products. Your role will directly shape the evolution of our crypto platform, propelling organizations into... the forefront of financial technology.

Responsibilities:
• Champion the DevOps roadmap, prioritizing tasks in alignment with organizational goals.
• Serve as a conduit between the DevOps team and various departments, fostering synergy and communication.
• Translate customer requirements into actionable insights for the DevOps teams.
• Document tasks for new initiatives and features, ensuring clarity and alignment.
• Facilitate elaboration meetings to ensure a shared understanding of project requirements.
• Maintain a streamlined product backlog, providing clear visibility of upcoming tasks to the development team.

Requirements

Qualifications:
• Solid IT background with significant product management experience.
• Innate curiosity to dissect and understand new product features thoroughly.
• Ability to swiftly grasp new concepts and articulate them clearly to meet customer needs.
• Proven track record in fast-paced, dynamic product development environments.
• Excellent communication skills, adept at conveying ideas across diverse organizational roles.
• Proficiency in Agile methodologies with a keen eye for detail and decision-making prowess.
• Willingness to step out of your comfort zone to ensure product excellence.
• International travel may be required.

Bonus Points:
• Technical expertise is advantageous.
• Previous experience in DevOps is a plus.
• Familiarity with Blockchain/Cryptocurrencies is highly desirable.

Benefits
• Flexible remote work or office options in the vibrant heart of Málaga.
• Engaging projects at an innovative international company leveraging cutting-edge technology and Apple equipment.
• Collaborative teams and a dynamic multicultural environment.
• Competitive salary with a flexible compensation plan.
• Work-life balance with flexible hours and ample vacation days.
• Comprehensive benefits package including private health insurance and relocation assistance.
• Continuous learning opportunities with free language lessons and professional development programs.
• Office perks including gaming consoles, fully stocked kitchen, and regular team events.
Certified Great Place to Work - Málaga Best Workplaces.

Join us in shaping the future of financial technology and enjoy a fulfilling career with us!

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services
jobs_results.description:
Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services

Country: Spain

SANTANDER DIGITAL SERVICES is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer based in one of our Hubs in Boadilla del Monte ,Cantabria and Málaga.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander (www.santander.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Digital Services (SDS) is the team of technology and operations at Santander. We are convinced of the importance of technology that is aligned with the requirements of the business and that out work not only brings value to users, people and communities but also fosters individual creativity. Our team of over 7,000 people in 8 countries (Spain, Portugal, Poland, UK, USA, Mexico, Chile and Brazil) develops and/or implements financial solutions across a broad spectrum of technologies (including Blockchain, Big Data and Angular among others) on all kinds of on-premises and cloud-based platforms.

UK Tower is... the Santander UK Nearshoring strategy vehicle in Santander Digital Services located in Spain, to provide technology workforce and services directly to Santander UK that will work together and for UK Technology teams.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all of our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will have the opportunity to lead and coordinate software projects in a highly dynamic and inventive environment.

We value delivering high-quality products that meet the needs of our customers. To this end, we are seeking candidates who will oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to deployment and beyond.

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Identifying, planning, and implementing solutions to improve the reliability, resilience and efficiency of the public cloud environment by developing innovative and automated processes.
• Providing high level advice on technical solutions and priorities for the infrastructure function.
• Focusing on day-to-day operations, delivery of new services and solutions and capacity planning to ensure IT infrastructure meets the current and future requirements of the organization.
• Ensuring the provision of full-service delivery, undertaking, and supporting structure planning to ensure sufficient system capacity is made available.
• Resolving complex technical issues and providing senior technical solutions in response to queries from across the business as well as from within IT.
• Analyzing technical specifications of systems infrastructure and communication platforms, to meet the needs of San UK
• Train the development team on design patterns and performance tuning strategies. Be passionate about making nitty gritty, hands-on improvements.
• Lead and mentor a team of engineers to further their technical prowess. You succeed when your team does!

EXPERIENCE
• +5 years of related experience.

EDUCATION
• University degree in technology, preferably in computer science.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
• Knowledge of DevOps tooling and methodologies including code repositories, bug tracking tools, Confluence, JIRA etc.
• Knowledge of IT incident management: ability to investigate, troubleshoot, recover and prevent the recurrence of incidents that interfere with the normal delivery of IT services.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Skills and experience in Change Control/Incident management of leading the recovery of infrastructure outages.
• A strong understanding of API orchestration, combined with languages such as Python to implement automated solutions and interactions between core management services such as Dynatrace, AWS, ServiceNow etc.
• Experience in software development and/or system administration, with a focus on reliability, availability, and scalability.
• Strong focus on design and delivery, taking complex problems and delivering well documented and tested solutions to those problems.

OTHER INFORMATION
• English at least C1
• Availability to travel if needed.

If you want to know more about us, visit our website https://www.betechwithsantander.com/en/home

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT THE WORK

As a DevOps engineer, you will be part of the Professional Services team, responsible for handling our internal and customers’ infrastructure and its provision and deploy automation in multi-cloud ecosystems.

You’ll be a key piece of our company for implementing Postgres over complex and high-performance production environments.

Think of IaC for setting up Postgres with high availability and automated failover, automated backups and restores, monitoring, distributed logging and many other bells & whistles that enterprise Postgres workloads require. Mostly on cloud and K8s, also on-premise.

All the work we do returns to the community, as open-source and/or knowledge sharing.
ABOUT THE TEAM

We like open source, we develop open-source software, and we are very active and well known at the PostgreSQL community. We build very innovative projects in the PostgreSQL ecosystem and we are the founders of Fundación PostgreSQL and PostgreSQL Ibiza.

The OnGres team is composed... of three main profiles:
• DBA experts from PostgreSQL, many of whom are Speakers at PostgreSQL conferences around the world.
• DevOps with experience. Troubleshooters, with automation in your heart and Linux as your world.
• Java programmers with deep experience in PostgreSQL. To create tools around PostgreSQL.

YOUR SKILLS

In order to be successful, you will need to bring your skills and knowledge around our main tech stack:
• We have extensive experience in Terraform to manage infrastructure, and Ansible to the automatically configuration in a controlled and repeatable way. Although, we consider infrastructure experience and lean code practice more important than specific technical knowledge.
• Bring AWS CDK expertise to impress us!
• Infrastructure Architecture knowledge, particularly on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
• We are using more and more Kubernetes. Container technology knowledge is required.
• Regarding Databases, we require PostgreSQL, as we are an “ON postGRES” company. Although we accept people with strong Database concepts, particularly on Relational.
• Strong Linux/*nix knowledge.
• You are a team player who values sharing and collaboration over solo plays. Really, we value teamwork abilities over other skills.

We have a multi-cloud environment, so would be great if you have experience with AWS, Azure or GCP.

Don’t worry if you don’t have much experience with PostgreSQL, your new colleagues, and our internal training will help you to acquire all the knowledge you will need. You just need to have the will to learn a lot and fast.

EXTRA BALLS

You will learn on the job many of the other tech pieces we use. Of course, it will be easier if you are already familiar with them:
• Git to manage all the code. We expect you are well familiar with Git workflows, and GitOps.
• Other Configuration Management tools: Chef, Puppet...
• SQL, it would be great if you are familiar with it.
• Programming/scripting: Bash, etc. A plus if you know some Java or Python.
• English: Almost all of our clients are international, so we work in English. The official language of the company is English. A basic work communication proficiency is required, we’ll take care of unrust your English through permanent training. On a daily basis, you will probably speak Spanish with your Spanish-speaking colleagues in our Madrid office, iff no other non-Spanish speakers or colleagues are not present. But all written communication, code and documentation is in English.

PERKS
• Full-time contract and a competitive salary.
• Awesome office in Alcobendas area, trendy and comfy. It has two terraces, a swimming pool and an arcade machine. Our office freeze is full of Spanish delicatessen, and we even have a wine cooler if you are a fancy Spanish wine lover -- once in a while, Argentinian wines will wildly appear.
• We expect you to work at our office, although working hours are flexible and you can work remotely when needed.
• You could choose your brand new laptop with OS of your choice (we recommend you to use Linux; MacOS worst case).
• Attend conferences as a listener, and we will encourage you to be a speaker. Also, we organize PGIBZ where the whole team will attend in 2020 (like we did in 2019).
• You can join our volleyball team, who is expected to compete Torneo Voley Playa Suances in July 2020.
• Challenging projects to work and grow with, using the latest technologies in a friendly and positive environment. We are a team and behave like such

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE

We’re currently seeking a DevOps Engineer to help our team on their next adventure. You will join an international and successful team and will report to the Tech Lead.

Your daily adventure :
• Administrate our cloud infrastructure in AWS and private cloud. Suggest improvements to the current setup.
• Provide technical guidance and educate team members on best practices in operations.
• Monitor metrics, provide observability to our infrastructure components and perform security audits.
• Define how to automate processes as well as deployment tasks. Own the deployment process to both internal and production environments.
• Set up CI / CD pipelines and educate the development teams to enforce a DevOps transformation.
• Update the DevOps processes for environment management including infrastructure, platform, and application lifecycle.
• Develop and document administration standards and procedures for internal and first-line support operations.
•... Periodically offer round-the-clock third-line support of the production environments, as part of a rotating on-call duty.

Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS

Are you serious about fun? Do you consistently seek out learning opportunities and aim to beat your high score? Are you open to new ideas, perspectives and cultures and believe that it takes a world to build a world?

At Ubisoft, you’ll work alongside passionate and talented teams who are imagining the future of entertainment.
• 2+ years’ experience as DevOps or equivalent.
• Strong experience with Linux-based infrastructures and AWS Cloud.
• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code best practices and tooling like Terraform.
• Docker and Kubernetes knowledge is a must.
• Experience with infrastructure automation.
• Experience with operations in a microservices architecture.
• Experience with CI / CD tools.
• Knowledge of Groovy and Bash.
• Be a team player : we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
• Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
• Should be open for on call duty.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
• Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus :
• Knowledge of Configuration as Code best practices.
• Knowledge of other Cloud providers like GCP or Azure is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python is a plus.
• Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, or related field. Master’s degree in any of these disciplines is a plus.
• Spanish or Catalan is a plus

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description: The Role Veeva OpenData supports the industry by providing real-time reference data across the complete healthcare ecosystem to support commercial sales execution, compliance, and business analytics. We drive value to our customers through constant innovation, using cloud-based solutions and state-of-the-art technologies to deliver product excellence and customer success. The OpenData Global Data Tools team delivers the tools and data processing pipelines used to build the global data core for life sciences in 100 countries. As a DevOps engineer contributing to the Global Data Tools team, you will manage the cloud system architecture and provisioning of cloud resources. You will also define the templates to configure CI/CD pipeline runs, build container agents, interconnect distributed resources, and apply security patches. You will promote and develop DevOps practices in the OpenData team.
